title: SES Road Tire
notes: Official store read 2026-11-01: US$75 per tire; tan or black, 25c-35c (black 31c unavailable). Tech specs: 25-622 240 g, 60-90 psi (4-6.25 bar); 27-622 245 g, 50-85 psi; 29-622 270 g, 40-80 psi; 31-622 285 g, 35-75 psi; 33-622 290 g, 30-70 psi; 35-622 290 g, 25-65 psi (Product Details lists 255/265/275/285 g for 25-31c). Natural and synthetic rubber with activated silica 'for All-Weather Performance'; Vectran protection barrier; 'Hookless and Hooked-Bead Rim Type Compatible'; tubeless ready, tube compatible. Applications from road race and TT (25-27c) to all-road and mixed-surface racing (29-35c). The 25c is listed N/A on 23-25 mm internal rims.
